_comment: The licence table every song's `license` key resolves against (songs/tools/canon.py, license_block). It used to live in songs/corpus.json alongside the song specs; the songs themselves are now the admin library's alone (library.json -> tools/fragment.py -> corpus-imports.json), but the licences must stay in git: they are what the site's credits page and songs.json reproduce, and a compliance obligation cannot depend on a mutable document in a bucket. `notice_file` is read verbatim (relative to songs/); `notice_text` is a template formatted with the song's spec, so {title}, {composer} and {sequencer} always resolve and anything else — {mutopia_id}, {cc0_source} — comes from the entry's `license_fields`.

mutopia-pd.notice_text: {title} — typeset by {sequencer} for the Mutopia Project ({mutopia_id}) and dedicated to the public domain by the typesetter ("The contributor of this music has dedicated their contribution into the public domain", https://www.mutopiaproject.org/legal.html). The composition itself is public domain.

cc0.notice_text: {title} by {composer} — released under the CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication ({cc0_source}).

owner-supplied.notice_text: Owner-supplied file imported from songs/import/; not redistributed with the repository.
